desc:
🥚 Welcome to Shovel Snow For Eggs!

Shovel through the snow to find RARE eggs buried underneath! ❄️

How to play:
⛏️ Shovel snow to gain Shovel Power
❄️ Shovel deep to uncover hidden eggs
🐔 Grab eggs and run from the giant Guards
🏠 Bring eggs back to your plot
🐣 Hatch eggs for RARE animals
💰 Your animals make you money
🚀 Buy better shovels to reach new zones

Your animals earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

🗺️ 8 zones to Shovel through
🥄 20 shovels, from Basic to Worldshaper
🤖 Auto Train and Auto Shovel while you relax

Can you find the rarest egg? 👀

Don't forget to like the game! 👍
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
